title: Fix test_common.cmake ASan detection broken repo-wide on Apple clang
description: check_c_compiler_flag("-fsanitize=address") in lichen/tests/cmake/test_common.cmake:48 fails on Apple clang (Xcode 26.6): the try-compile links WITHOUT the flag on the link line, ___asan_init is undefined, _has_asan caches false, and ASan is silently dropped for EVERY host test dir even though lichen_test_target() applies _san_flags to both compile and link options (lines 62-65). Verified empirically 2026-08-28: tx_queue binary without the per-test workaround links only ubsan runtime; with CMAKE_REQUIRED_LINK_OPTIONS re-check it links libclang_rt.asan_osx_dynamic.dylib. Fix once in test_common.cmake (set CMAKE_REQUIRED_LINK_OPTIONS before the check), then remove the per-test workaround in lichen/tests/tx_queue/CMakeLists.txt. COORDINATION: doing this mid-multi-agent-session flips sanitizer behavior for all concurrent test builds; latent UB in other dirs will start failing tests. Land it when no other waves are in flight.
